review.verbatim_critique:
[D0.5.G cold referee] delivered tier=incremental below novelty_target=field (floor=field). The TL;DR and project justification claim a proved observable covariance approximation and feasible path coverage, but the class never requires the target pre-treatment mean bary to lie in col(barY). When its population residual is nonzero, perturbing the PCR singular space produces a first-order design-rotation term involving E_Y-transpose r_y that is absent from the stated leading score and cannot generally be absorbed by the reported standardized remainder. The same omission invalidates the proof that the pooled residual estimator consistently estimates sigma squared, because the unit-response residual sum of squares can contain an order-n signal component. Consequently the central Gram-consistency and feasible-coverage conclusions are not proved uniformly over the declared class; what remains is the narrower Gaussian-score complexity characterization, persistent examples, and an estimator-centered rectangle lower bound. The highly specialized Gaussian, exact-rank, disjoint-block setting and the lower bound's restriction to the prescribed Gaussian center further limit the projected leading-journal contribution. [D0.5.G projected paper-score gate: paper_score_ceiling 4.8 < 7.4, so the graded tier 'subfield' is capped at 'incremental'. The score assesses the delivered research package without credit for unfinished work.]

HALTED AT TRIAGE: the math panel returned `revise` and its findings were never repaired, so this note is NOT established as mathematically sound — do not bank it as downgraded on this verdict alone. Open findings: omitted_projection_residual_terms@thm:stacked-orthogonal-expansion, related_work_incomplete@thm:uniform-selected-band
